manifest.grid: r from x0 to x1 and z from y0 to y1 in mm; mirror about the axis, and for a dipole about z = 0 too (wire.mirror_z)
manifest.wire: the wire's radius and height above z = 0 (half the dipole) and the feed gap, mm
manifest.pattern: gain in dBi against the angle from the wire's axis, degrees, at the working frequency
manifest.sweep: x is frequency in MHz, with S11 in dB and the input resistance and reactance in ohm
manifest.h_rms: for each sweep frequency, the rms azimuthal magnetic field on the grid, A/m, when a 50 ohm source of tx_power_W available power drives the antenna, all packed on one range clipped at the 98th percentile (the field grows without bound at the wire)
manifest.patterns: for each sweep frequency, the gain in dBi at pattern.theta_deg
manifest.range.curves: received power against distance (x in m, dBm) for the median, the reliable fraction of spots and free space
manifest.range.range_median_m: distance reached in half of spots, m
manifest.range.range_reliable_m: distance reached in the reliability fraction of spots, m
